Six grades of steam power GTSR: plain Steam, Superheated Steam and Supercritical Steam, each with a Dense variant — Dense Steam, Dense Superheated and Dense Supercritical.

Plain grades come from GT boilers and GTSR producers; superheated steam is what the gear-driven compressor and the chipped geothermal boiler put out; dense variants are 1,000:1 compressed by the Dense State Manipulator; supercritical grades feed the singularity machines.

Superheated steam runs steam-base multiblocks at 4x speed for 4x the steam — even on bronze tier.
